Decap CMS 3.17.3 (MIT). Bundled assets copied from the npm registry package `decap-cms@3.17.3`, without source maps. See decap-cms.js.LICENSE.txt for bundled dependency notices. Reproduce with `npm install --prefix /tmp/mh-cms --ignore-scripts decap-cms@3.17.3`, then copy dist/decap-cms.js, *.decap-cms.js, *.wasm, *.css, and decap-cms.js.LICENSE.txt. Arabic locale is a local adaptation of decap-cms-locales 3.9.0 English strings (MIT).
